card.name: Broken bytes of bullets and Lao script
card.fires_on: Mostly the broken half of a special character, such as a bullet symbol before a list item or a piece of Lao script. Weaker hits on 'nervous' after 'central' and on odd word endings.

modes.label: Bullet symbol pieces

modes.label: Lao script pieces
